title: Qwen 3.8 27B available on Cerebras at 1500 tokens/s
summary: Cerebras announces support for Qwen 3.8 27B, delivering inference at 1500 tokens per second, a significant speed milestone. This highlights Cerebras's custom hardware advantage for large model deployment, appealing to developers seeking ultra-low-latency responses. The discussion on Hacker News focuses on performance benchmarks, hardware implications, and practical use cases.
